Your next few Fridays, sorted 🗓️

Conway The Machine drops OTIS this Friday, the same day Danz CM puts out the album she spent four years making alone at home. Then @dontoliver returns Dec 4 with Nitrous, which he recorded and produced all by himself.

Which one are you running first?

Want to back artists like these early? Get on the waitlist at riffex.app.
